question: As per the Human Development Report, 2021-22 (UNDP), which of the following neighbouring countries of India has the highest ranking in the Human Development Index?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Lanka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• As per the Human Development Report 2021-22 published by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), Sri Lanka ranks the highest among India's neighboring countries in the Human Development Index (HDI).
 
• Sri Lanka achieved an HDI ranking of 73 out of 191 countries globally, showcasing its significant progress in human development indicators.
 
• The HDI measures three primary dimensions: life expectancy, education (mean and expected years of schooling), and standard of living (Gross National Income per capita).
